svg.title: Relay Orchard: 3-day restoration system design
svg.desc: A one-page heavy design for Relay Orchard, a solo 3-day desktop game about repairing a radio observatory. Six linked subsystems show a spatial travel map, local rules with stable IDs, a normal 3-day win trace, an energy-shortage recovery trace, and open decisions.

g.text: What must the player track over 3 days to repair the receiver and install the relay before Day 3 ends?
Scope: full 3-day restoration; solo desktop; AP/energy/resource economy
R-01: 6 AP/day; an action needs its AP + resources to start
AP6 En6 Wtr2 Scr2; rest start 0.
Names next dawn: clear or storm.
Cuts combined dawn fruit yield by 1.
END DAY: return to Workshop; next dawn AP6 (R-02).
R-03: every leg costs 1 AP + 1 energy; bidirectional
No route connects Grove, Reservoir, or Observatory directly.
Player starts Day 1 at Workshop. Charger (subsystem 3) works at any node.
The map shows legal travel; other panels explain costs and resource dependencies.
Any location: 1 AP to gain 2 energy.
Dawn resets AP only, not energy.
Entailed by R-02; see both traces
FRUIT: trade at Workshop (R-09), after dawn yield (R-06b/R-07).
No other trades exist at Workshop.
SCRAP: funds receiver repair (R-12) and relay installation (R-13).
WIN if installed before Day 3 ends (R-13)
NORMAL TRACE / 3-DAY WIN (clear weather both dawns)
1. Dawn 1, Workshop: AP6 En6 Wtr2 Scr2 Frt0 Cred0 Res0 (R-01, R-01b).
2. To Grove (R-03): AP5 En5. Tend (R-06a): AP4 Wtr1, +1 marker.
3. To Workshop, to Observatory (R-03 x2): AP2 En3. Repair (R-12): AP1 Scr0.
4. Scan (R-11): AP0 En1 Res1. No AP-costing action can start; player ends the day.
5. Dawn 2, clear: marker matures, +2 fruit (R-06b). Start: AP6 En1 Wtr1 Frt2 Res1.
6. Charge (R-04): AP5 En3. Sell fruit (R-09): AP4 Cred3. Buy scrap (R-10): AP3 Scr1.
7. To Observatory: AP2 En2. Scan: AP1 En0 Res2. Player ends Day 2 with 1 AP unused.
8. Dawn 3: AP6 En0 Scr1 Res2. Charge (R-04): AP5 En2. To Observatory: AP4 En1.
9. Install (R-13): AP2 Res0 Scr0. Done before Day 3 ends: WIN (AP2, En1 spare).
The required energy-shortage recovery trace appears at right.
1. Resume at Day 3 start (from the normal trace above): AP6 En0 Wtr1 Scr1 Res2 Cred1.
2. Attempt: to Observatory (R-03; needs 1 AP + 1 energy). BLOCKED: has 0 energy.
3. State is unchanged: AP6 En0 (R-01, R-15 name the missing prerequisite).
4. Charge (R-04): cost 1 AP, gain 2 energy. AP5 En2.
5. Resume: to Observatory (R-03) now succeeds: AP4 En1. Repair persists (R-12).
6. Install (R-13): AP2 Res0 Scr0. Done before Day 3 ends: WIN (AP2, En1 spare).
A disabled action names its missing prerequisite in the live HUD (R-15); step 2 is that case.
Experience: feel resourceful and caring while restoring the orchard's observatory.
Win: install the relay before Day 3 ends (R-13). Loss: incomplete restoration (R-14).
Q-01 OPEN: weather schedule/random model; the forecast is accurate.
Q-02 OPEN: story consequence after incomplete restoration.
Q-03 OPEN: replay behavior after incomplete restoration.
Q-04 OPEN: saving progress between real-world play sessions.
PLAYTEST T-01 (test hypothesis, not a confirmed rule):
Can new players identify the missing energy and use the charger without help?
No combat, multiplayer, monetization, equipment leveling, or procedural map (C-02).
Open items stay open. This page does not silently resolve them as confirmed rules.
